```{r Step 2: Initial Modeling for Government Service Provision Among Black Respondents, include=TRUE}
black_services_svy_models <- lapply(
  sort(unique(black_anes$year)),
  function(y) {
    
    data_y <- black_anes %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(government_services),
        !is.na(income_group_factor),
        !is.na(stock_owns),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )
    
    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )
    
    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      government_services ~ income_group_factor * stock_owns,
      design = design_y
    )
    
    list(
      year = y,
      model = mod,
      n = nrow(data_y)
    )
  }
)

black_services_svy_models

black_services_predictions <- lapply(
  black_services_svy_models,
  function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)

    income_levels <- levels(
      model.frame(x$model)$income_group_factor
    )

    marginaleffects::predictions(
      x$model,
      newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
        income_group_factor = income_levels,
        stock_owns = c(0, 1)
      )
    ) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(
        year = x$year,
        stock_group = factor(
          stock_owns,
          levels = c(0, 1),
          labels = c("Non-stock owners", "Stock owners")
        )
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()

black_services_predictions
```

```{r Step 4: Joint Tests for Both Outcomes, include=TRUE}
get_income_stock_joint_tests <- function(model_list) {
  
  lapply(
    model_list,
    function(x) {
      
      if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
      
      mod <- x$model
      
      interaction_idx <- grep(
        "^income_group_factor.*:stock_owns$",
        names(coef(mod))
      )
      
      beta <- coef(mod)[interaction_idx]
      
      V <- vcov(mod)[
        interaction_idx,
        interaction_idx,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      
      W <- as.numeric(
        t(beta) %*% solve(V) %*% beta
      )
      
      q <- length(beta)
      
      F_stat <- W / q
      df_den <- mod$df.residual
      
      p_value <- pf(
        F_stat,
        df1 = q,
        df2 = df_den,
        lower.tail = FALSE
      )
      
      data.frame(
        year = x$year,
        n = x$n,
        F = F_stat,
        df_num = q,
        df_den = df_den,
        p.value = p_value
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    arrange(year)
}

black_services_joint_tests <- get_income_stock_joint_tests(
  black_services_svy_models
)

black_jobs_joint_tests <- get_income_stock_joint_tests(
  black_jobs_svy_models
)

black_services_joint_tests
black_jobs_joint_tests
```

```{r Step 5: Creating a Table for All Four Outcomes, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# Black respondents: 3-category income × stock sensitivity
# analysis for four outcomes
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create collapsed three-category income variable
# ------------------------------------------------------------

black_anes <- black_anes %>%
  mutate(
    income_3cat = case_when(
      income_group %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Lower income",
      income_group == 3 ~ "Middle income",
      income_group %in% c(4, 5) ~ "Upper income",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    income_3cat = factor(
      income_3cat,
      levels = c(
        "Lower income",
        "Middle income",
        "Upper income"
      )
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Function to estimate year-specific survey models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_black_income_stock_models <- function(data, outcome) {

  lapply(
    sort(unique(data$year)),
    function(y) {

      data_y <- data %>%
        filter(
          year == y,
          !is.na(.data[[outcome]]),
          !is.na(income_3cat),
          !is.na(stock_owns),
          !is.na(VCF0009z)
        )

      if (nrow(data_y) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      design_y <- survey::svydesign(
        ids = ~1,
        weights = ~VCF0009z,
        data = data_y
      )

      mod <- survey::svyglm(
        as.formula(
          paste0(
            outcome,
            " ~ income_3cat * stock_owns"
          )
        ),
        design = design_y
      )

      list(
        year = y,
        model = mod,
        n = nrow(data_y),
        outcome = outcome
      )
    }
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Run models for all four outcomes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

black_affirmative_3cat_models <- 
  run_black_income_stock_models(
    black_anes,
    "affirmative_action"
  )

black_hardworking_3cat_models <- 
  run_black_income_stock_models(
    black_anes,
    "black_hardworking"
  )

black_services_3cat_models <- 
  run_black_income_stock_models(
    black_anes,
    "government_services"
  )

black_jobs_3cat_models <- 
  run_black_income_stock_models(
    black_anes,
    "government_jobs_rev"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Function for omnibus income × stock test
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_3cat_income_stock_joint_tests <- function(model_list) {

  lapply(
    model_list,
    function(x) {

      if (is.null(x)) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      mod <- x$model

      # Identify all income × stock interaction terms
      interaction_idx <- grep(
        "^income_3cat.*:stock_owns$",
        names(coef(mod))
      )

      # If no interaction terms are estimable
      if (length(interaction_idx) == 0) {
        return(
          data.frame(
            year = x$year,
            n = x$n,
            F = NA_real_,
            df_num = NA_integer_,
            df_den = mod$df.residual,
            p.value = NA_real_,
            outcome = x$outcome
          )
        )
      }

      beta <- coef(mod)[interaction_idx]

      V <- vcov(mod)[
        interaction_idx,
        interaction_idx,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      # Wald statistic
      W <- as.numeric(
        t(beta) %*% solve(V) %*% beta
      )

      q <- length(beta)

      F_stat <- W / q

      df_den <- mod$df.residual

      p_value <- pf(
        F_stat,
        df1 = q,
        df2 = df_den,
        lower.tail = FALSE
      )

      data.frame(
        year = x$year,
        n = x$n,
        F = F_stat,
        df_num = q,
        df_den = df_den,
        p.value = p_value,
        outcome = x$outcome
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    arrange(year)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Generate omnibus tests for all four outcomes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

black_affirmative_3cat_tests <-
  get_3cat_income_stock_joint_tests(
    black_affirmative_3cat_models
  )

black_hardworking_3cat_tests <-
  get_3cat_income_stock_joint_tests(
    black_hardworking_3cat_models
  )

black_services_3cat_tests <-
  get_3cat_income_stock_joint_tests(
    black_services_3cat_models
  )

black_jobs_3cat_tests <-
  get_3cat_income_stock_joint_tests(
    black_jobs_3cat_models
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Combine into ONE clean table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

black_3cat_omnibus_tests <- bind_rows(
  black_affirmative_3cat_tests,
  black_hardworking_3cat_tests,
  black_services_3cat_tests,
  black_jobs_3cat_tests
) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = recode(
      outcome,
      affirmative_action = "Affirmative action",
      black_hardworking = "Hardworking attribution",
      government_services = "Government services",
      government_jobs_rev = "Government responsibility for jobs"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    outcome,
    year,
    n,
    F,
    df_num,
    df_den,
    p.value
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    outcome
  )


# Display table
black_3cat_omnibus_tests

#Reformat Table
black_3cat_omnibus_wide <- black_3cat_omnibus_tests %>%
  mutate(
    result = paste0(
      "F(",
      df_num,
      ", ",
      df_den,
      ") = ",
      round(F, 2),
      ", p = ",
      format.pval(
        p.value,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 0.001
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    outcome,
    result
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = outcome,
    values_from = result
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)

black_3cat_omnibus_wide
```

```{r Step 6: Additional Sensitivity Test, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# Predicted values from the 3-category income × stock models
# ============================================================

get_3cat_predictions <- function(model_list) {

  lapply(
    model_list,
    function(x) {

      if (is.null(x)) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      # Only use income categories actually estimated
      income_levels <- levels(
        model.frame(x$model)$income_3cat
      )

      marginaleffects::predictions(
        x$model,
        newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
          income_3cat = income_levels,
          stock_owns = c(0, 1)
        )
      ) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        mutate(
          year = x$year,
          outcome = x$outcome,
          stock_group = factor(
            stock_owns,
            levels = c(0, 1),
            labels = c(
              "Non-stock owners",
              "Stock owners"
            )
          )
        )
    }
  ) %>%
    bind_rows()
}


# Generate predictions
black_affirmative_3cat_predictions <-
  get_3cat_predictions(
    black_affirmative_3cat_models
  )

black_hardworking_3cat_predictions <-
  get_3cat_predictions(
    black_hardworking_3cat_models
  )

black_services_3cat_predictions <-
  get_3cat_predictions(
    black_services_3cat_models
  )

black_jobs_3cat_predictions <-
  get_3cat_predictions(
    black_jobs_3cat_models
  )


black_3cat_predictions <- bind_rows(
  black_affirmative_3cat_predictions,
  black_hardworking_3cat_predictions,
  black_services_3cat_predictions,
  black_jobs_3cat_predictions
) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = recode(
      outcome,
      affirmative_action = "Affirmative action",
      black_hardworking = "Hardworking attribution",
      government_services = "Government services",
      government_jobs_rev =
        "Government responsibility for jobs"
    )
  )

black_3cat_predictions %>%
  filter(
    (outcome == "Affirmative action" &
       year %in% c(2020, 2024)) |
    (outcome == "Hardworking attribution" &
       year %in% c(2004, 2012)) |
    (outcome == "Government services" &
       year == 2000) |
    (outcome == "Government responsibility for jobs" &
       year %in% c(2004, 2012))
  ) %>%
  select(
    outcome,
    year,
    income_3cat,
    stock_group,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome, year, income_3cat, stock_group)



black_3cat_predictions %>%
  filter(
    outcome == "Affirmative action",
    year %in% c(2008, 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = income_3cat,
      y = estimate,
      group = stock_group,
      linetype = stock_group
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ year) +
  labs(
    x = "Income group",
    y = "Predicted affirmative-action support",
    linetype = NULL,
    title = "Affirmative-action attitudes by income and stock ownership"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


black_3cat_predictions %>%
  filter(
    outcome == "Hardworking attribution",
    year %in% c(2004, 2012)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = income_3cat,
      y = estimate,
      group = stock_group,
      linetype = stock_group
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = conf.low,
      ymax = conf.high
    ),
    width = 0.08
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ year) +
  labs(
    x = "Income group",

    linetype = NULL,
    title = "Hardworking attribution by income and stock ownership"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


black_3cat_predictions %>%
  filter(
    outcome == "Government services",
    year %in% c(2012, 2020, 2024)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(

  ) +

black_3cat_predictions %>%
```
